decisions.reason: Displaying the referral code on the NFT does not change how referral identity or other NFT attributes behave after transfer.
The referral-code display location does not change the selected Base blockchain network.
Making the referral code visible on the NFT does not alter secondary-sale royalty amount, structure, or disclosure.
The candidate already has a complete message-146 MODIFY adding the NFT itself to referral_code_display_locations.
Referral-code visibility does not change commission allocation when a mint has no referral code.
The display location of a referral code does not change the coded-referral commission amount, recipient, trigger, or payout behavior.
Showing the referral code on the NFT does not change ticket issuance quantities or the ticket recipient.
The candidate already has a message-146 MODIFY replacing the FAQ with the supplied revised copy, so no additional propagation is required.
Referral-code visibility does not alter badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
The NFT referral-code display location does not change the Transak provider, payment methods, or wallet requirements.
Displaying a referral code on the NFT does not change ticket allocation for mints that provide no referral code.
Referral-code visibility does not alter the NFT ebook format or its unlimited supply.
